      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__campaign_report
      business_logic: '- Group campaign-level rows by platform, account_id normalized by replacing NULL with ''0'' and casting to text, and date_day. - Set segmentation fields not used at account level to NULL: ad_network_type, device, interaction_event_types. - Aggregate totals across all campaigns in each group: - Sum impressions, clicks, interactions, cost, conversions, conversions_value, and view_through_conversions; missing values are ignored, and if all values are missing the result is NULL. - For active view sums (impressions, measurable impressions, measurable cost), treat missing row values as 0 before summing; if all inputs are missing the result is 0. - For active view averages (measurability, viewability), treat missing row values as 0 and take the unweighted average across rows. - Derived metrics (computed from the aggregated totals): - Click-through rate (percent) = total clicks / total impressions × 100, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 if total impressions is not greater than 0; returns NULL if total clicks is NULL while impressions are positive. - Cost per click = total cost / total clicks, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 if total clicks is not greater than 0; returns NULL if total cost is NULL while clicks are positive. - Cost per thousand impressions = total cost / total impressions × 1000, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 if total impressions is not greater than 0; returns NULL if total cost is NULL while impressions are positive. - Cost per conversion = total cost / total conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 if total conversions is not greater than 0; returns NULL if total cost is NULL while conversions are positive. - Return on ad spend = total conversion value / total cost, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 unless both totals are greater than 0. - _dbt_loaded_at is the latest timestamp across grouped rows (MAX); if all inputs are missing, the result is NULL.'

        description: Unweighted average of viewability with missing values treated as 0

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'CTR in percent: (total clicks/total impressions)×100, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 if impressions not > 0; NULL if clicks total is NULL while impressions are positive'
      - name: cost_per_click

- name: int_ad_reporting__customer_journey_analysis
      description: Aggregated customer journey metrics and classifications across ad platforms (one row per customer within the last 12 months)
      grain: One row per customer_identifier with first_interaction_date within the last 12 months
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report
      - raw.facebook_ads_basic_ad_data
      business_logic: '- Build customer_touchpoints by unifying: - Google Ads: platform=''google_ads''; use account_id as both customer_id and account_id; include campaign_id, date_day, impressions, clicks, spend as cost, conversions, conversions_value; keep only rows with account_id present. - Amazon Ads: platform=''amazon_ads''; no customer_id or account_id; include campaign_id, date_day, impressions, clicks, cost, purchases_30_d as conversions, sales_30_d as revenue_30d. - Facebook Ads: platform=''facebook_ads''; no customer_id; use account_id; set campaign_id from ad_id (as text), date_day from date; include impressions, inline_link_clicks as clicks, spend as cost; set conversions to 0. - For each touchpoint: - customer_identifier uses customer_id when available; otherwise account_id as text; otherwise the string ''UNKNOWN_'' followed by campaign_id. - revenue per touchpoint uses conversions_value when present; otherwise revenue_30d; otherwise 0. - interaction_type is ''CONVERTING_CLICK'' when both clicks and conversions are positive; ''NON_CONVERTING_CLICK'' when clicks are positive only; ''IMPRESSION_ONLY'' when impressions are positive only; otherwise ''OTHER''. - Aggregate per customer_identifier into customer_segments: - active_days is the count of unique interaction dates; platforms_used is the count of unique platforms; campaigns_interacted is the count of unique campaigns. - total_impressions, total_clicks, total_cost, total_conversions, and total_revenue are sums over touchpoints (adding only non-null values). - first_interaction_date is the earliest interaction date; last_interaction_date is the latest; customer_lifespan_days is the number of days between them. - click_to_conversion_rate is conversions divided by clicks, scaled by 100 and rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when clicks are missing or not positive. - impression_to_click_rate is clicks divided by impressions, scaled by 100 and rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when impressions are missing or not positive. - average_order_value is revenue divided by conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when conversions are missing or not positive. - customer_roas is revenue divided by cost, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when cost is missing or not positive. - Final output per customer_identifier: - acquisition_cohort is the month of first_interaction_date; days_since_acquisition is the days from first_interaction_date to today. - customer_value_tier by total_revenue: >=1000 HIGH_VALUE; >=500 MEDIUM_VALUE; >=100 LOW_VALUE; >0 MINIMAL_VALUE; else NO_VALUE. - engagement_level: if active_days>=10 and platforms_used>=2 then HIGHLY_ENGAGED; else if active_days>=5 or platforms_used>=2 then MODERATELY_ENGAGED; else if active_days>=2 then LIGHTLY_ENGAGED; else SINGLE_INTERACTION. - conversion_behavior by total_conversions: >=5 FREQUENT_CONVERTER; >=2 REPEAT_CONVERTER; =1 SINGLE_CONVERTER; else NON_CONVERTER. - recency_status by days since last_interaction_date: <=7 RECENT; <=30 MODERATE; <=90 DORMANT; else INACTIVE. - total_cost_attributed equals total_cost; all attribution revenue fields equal total_revenue. - Cohort placeholders: cohort_size=100; retained_month_1=85; retained_month_2=72; retained_month_3=63; retention_rate_month_1=85.0; retention_rate_month_2=72.0; retention_rate_month_3=63.0. - analysis_generated_at is the run timestamp with timezone. - Filter: keep customers with first_interaction_date in the last 12 months; order by total_revenue descending, then customer_identifier ascending. - Determinism and null policy: - Per-touchpoint revenue is never null due to fallback; sums add non-null values and yield null only if all inputs are null. - Percentage rates are on a 0–100 scale, rounded as stated, and default to 0 when the denominator is missing or not positive. - Distinct counts exclude nulls and do not count duplicates.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_identifier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier uses customer_id; else account_id as text; else 'UNKNOWN_' plus campaign_id; one row per identifier
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: acquisition_cohort
        data_type: DATE
        description: Month of first_interaction_date
      - name: first_interaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest interaction date for the customer
      - name: last_interaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest interaction date for the customer
      - name: customer_lifespan_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between the first and last interaction dates
      - name: days_since_acquisition
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from first_interaction_date to today
      - name: customer_value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by total_revenue: >=1000 HIGH_VALUE; >=500 MEDIUM_VALUE; >=100 LOW_VALUE; >0 MINIMAL_VALUE; else NO_VALUE'
      - name: engagement_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on active_days and platforms_used: (>=10 and >=2) HIGHLY_ENGAGED; (>=5 or >=2) MODERATELY_ENGAGED; (>=2) LIGHTLY_ENGAGED; else SINGLE_INTERACTION'
      - name: conversion_behavior
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on total_conversions: >=5 FREQUENT_CONVERTER; >=2 REPEAT_CONVERTER; =1 SINGLE_CONVERTER; else NON_CONVERTER'
      - name: recency_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on days since last_interaction_date: <=7 RECENT; <=30 MODERATE; <=90 DORMANT; else INACTIVE'
      - name: active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique interaction dates; null dates excluded
      - name: platforms_used
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique platforms used
      - name: campaigns_interacted
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique campaigns; nulls excluded
      - name: total_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions across touchpoints; ignores nulls; null if all inputs are null
      - name: total_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks across touchpoints; ignores nulls; null if all inputs are null
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of conversions; ignores nulls; null if all inputs are null; integer-valued stored as decimal
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of per-touchpoint revenue using conversions_value, else revenue_30d, else 0; never null
      - name: total_cost_attributed
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of cost across touchpoints; ignores nulls; null if all inputs are null
      - name: click_to_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 100 × conversions ÷ clicks; rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when clicks are missing or not positive
      - name: impression_to_click_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 100 × clicks ÷ impressions; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions are missing or not positive
      - name: average_order_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue ÷ conversions; rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when conversions are missing or not positive
      - name: customer_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue ÷ cost; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when cost is missing or not positive
      - name: total_first_touch_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Equal to total_revenue (simplified attribution)
      - name: total_last_touch_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Equal to total_revenue (simplified attribution)
      - name: total_linear_attributed_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Equal to total_revenue (simplified attribution)
      - name: total_time_decay_attributed_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Equal to total_revenue (simplified attribution)
      - name: cohort_size
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 100 for all rows
      - name: retained_month_1
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 85 for all rows
      - name: retained_month_2
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 72 for all rows
      - name: retained_month_3
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 63 for all rows
      - name: retention_rate_month_1
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Fixed value 85.0 (percentage on 0–100 scale)
      - name: retention_rate_month_2
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Fixed value 72.0 (percentage on 0–100 scale)
      - name: retention_rate_month_3
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Fixed value 63.0 (percentage on 0–100 scale)
      - name: analysis_generated_at

specification.grain: One row per customer_identifier with first_interaction_date within the last 12 months
specification.business_logic: - Build customer_touchpoints by unifying: - Google Ads: platform='google_ads'; use account_id as both customer_id and account_id; include campaign_id, date_day, impressions, clicks, spend as cost, conversions, conversions_value; keep only rows with account_id present. - Amazon Ads: platform='amazon_ads'; no customer_id or account_id; include campaign_id, date_day, impressions, clicks, cost, purchases_30_d as conversions, sales_30_d as revenue_30d. - Facebook Ads: platform='facebook_ads'; no customer_id; use account_id; set campaign_id from ad_id (as text), date_day from date; include impressions, inline_link_clicks as clicks, spend as cost; set conversions to 0. - For each touchpoint: - customer_identifier uses customer_id when available; otherwise account_id as text; otherwise the string 'UNKNOWN_' followed by campaign_id. - revenue per touchpoint uses conversions_value when present; otherwise revenue_30d; otherwise 0. - interaction_type is 'CONVERTING_CLICK' when both clicks and conversions are positive; 'NON_CONVERTING_CLICK' when clicks are positive only; 'IMPRESSION_ONLY' when impressions are positive only; otherwise 'OTHER'. - Aggregate per customer_identifier into customer_segments: - active_days is the count of unique interaction dates; platforms_used is the count of unique platforms; campaigns_interacted is the count of unique campaigns. - total_impressions, total_clicks, total_cost, total_conversions, and total_revenue are sums over touchpoints (adding only non-null values). - first_interaction_date is the earliest interaction date; last_interaction_date is the latest; customer_lifespan_days is the number of days between them. - click_to_conversion_rate is conversions divided by clicks, scaled by 100 and rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when clicks are missing or not positive. - impression_to_click_rate is clicks divided by impressions, scaled by 100 and rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when impressions are missing or not positive. - average_order_value is revenue divided by conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when conversions are missing or not positive. - customer_roas is revenue divided by cost, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when cost is missing or not positive. - Final output per customer_identifier: - acquisition_cohort is the month of first_interaction_date; days_since_acquisition is the days from first_interaction_date to today. - customer_value_tier by total_revenue: >=1000 HIGH_VALUE; >=500 MEDIUM_VALUE; >=100 LOW_VALUE; >0 MINIMAL_VALUE; else NO_VALUE. - engagement_level: if active_days>=10 and platforms_used>=2 then HIGHLY_ENGAGED; else if active_days>=5 or platforms_used>=2 then MODERATELY_ENGAGED; else if active_days>=2 then LIGHTLY_ENGAGED; else SINGLE_INTERACTION. - conversion_behavior by total_conversions: >=5 FREQUENT_CONVERTER; >=2 REPEAT_CONVERTER; =1 SINGLE_CONVERTER; else NON_CONVERTER. - recency_status by days since last_interaction_date: <=7 RECENT; retained_month_2=72; retained_month_3=63; retention_rate_month_1=85.0; retention_rate_month_2=72.0; retention_rate_month_3=63.0. - analysis_generated_at is the run timestamp with timezone. - Filter: keep customers with first_interaction_date in the last 12 months; order by total_revenue descending, then customer_identifier ascending. - Determinism and null policy: - Per-touchpoint revenue is never null due to fallback; sums add non-null values and yield null only if all inputs are null. - Percentage rates are on a 0–100 scale, rounded as stated, and default to 0 when the denominator is missing or not positive. - Distinct counts exclude nulls and do not count duplicates.

      grain: One row per (platform, country_code, account_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, month_year)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__campaign_report
      business_logic: '- Source rows come from intermediate.int_ad_reporting__campaign_report and must have a non-null date_day. - Derive country_code by platform: google_ads → US, facebook_ads → US, amazon_ads → US, otherwise Unknown. - Derive time fields: month_year as the first day of the month for date_day; year and month as the calendar year and month of date_day. - Group by platform, country_code, month_year, year, month, account_id, campaign_id, and campaign_name. - Aggregate totals over each group: - Standard totals (impressions, clicks, interactions, cost, conversions, conversions_value, view_through_conversions) sum available values; the result is null if all inputs are null. - Platform-specific totals (active_view_impressions, active_view_measurable_impressions, attributed_sales_14_d, attributed_sales_30_d, attributed_conversions_14_d, attributed_conversions_30_d) treat missing values as zero before summing. - Compute monthly KPIs using the aggregated totals: - Click-through rate: 100 × total_clicks / total_impressions, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when total_impressions is not positive. - Cost per click: total_cost / total_clicks, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when total_clicks is not positive. - Cost per thousand impressions: 1000 × total_cost / total_impressions, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when total_impressions is not positive. - Cost per conversion: total_cost / total_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when total_conversions is not positive. - Return on ad spend: total_conversions_value / total_cost, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when total_cost or total_conversions_value is not positive. - Amazon 30-day ROAS: total_attributed_sales_30_d / total_cost, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when total_cost or total_attributed_sales_30_d is not positive. - Activity and averages: - days_active_in_month is the count of distinct date_day values in the group. - avg_daily_spend is total_cost divided by days_active_in_month, rounded to 2 decimals; - name: int_ad_reporting__monthly_campaign_region_report
      description: Monthly campaign-level regional rollups with platform-derived region mapping and aggregated performance metrics
      grain: One row per platform, region, month_year, year, month, account_id, campaign_id, campaign_name
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__campaign_report
      business_logic: '- Source: intermediate.int_ad_reporting__campaign_report; include only rows where date_day is not null. - Derive geography per row: - region by platform: google_ads/facebook_ads/amazon_ads/linkedin_ads/microsoft_ads/pinterest_ads/snapchat_ads/reddit_ads/apple_search_ads → North America; tiktok_ads/twitter_ads → Global; else Unknown. - country_code by platform: google_ads/facebook_ads/amazon_ads → US; else Unknown. - Group by keys: platform, region, account_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, and time fields where: - month_year is the first day of the month for date_day; year is the calendar year; month is the calendar month number (1–12). - Geographic aggregates: - countries_in_region counts distinct country_code values. - country_list concatenates distinct country_code values separated by ", ", ordered ascending, excluding nulls, preserving original casing. - Aggregate metrics: - Sum impressions, clicks, interactions, cost, conversions, conversions_value, and view_through_conversions (nulls ignored). - For active_view_impressions, active_view_measurable_impressions, attributed_sales_14_d, attributed_sales_30_d, attributed_conversions_14_d, attributed_conversions_30_d: treat nulls as 0 before summing. - Derived monthly regional KPIs (division-by-zero handling and rounding): - Click-through rate: 100 times clicks divided by impressions over the group, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions are 0. - Cost per click: cost divided by clicks, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when clicks are 0. - Cost per thousand impressions: cost per 1,000 impressions, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when impressions are 0. - Cost per conversion: cost divided by conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when conversions are 0. - Return on ad spend: conversions_value divided by cost, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when cost or conversions_value is 0. - Amazon ROAS 30d: attributed_sales_30_d divided by cost, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when cost or attributed_sales_30_d is 0. - Activity and daily averages: - days_active_in_month counts distinct active dates. - avg_daily_regional_spend: total cost divided by days_active_in_month, rounded to 2 decimals. - avg_daily_regional_impressions: total impressions divided by days_active_in_month, rounded to 0 decimals. - avg_daily_regional_clicks: total clicks divided by days_active_in_month, rounded to 0 decimals. - Platform-month share and concentration (computed across all regions within each platform and month): - regional_cost_share_pct: percent of platform-month total cost contributed by the group, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when the platform-month total is 0. - regional_impression_share_pct: percent of platform-month total impressions contributed by the group, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when the platform-month total is 0. - regional_cost_concentration: fraction of platform-month total cost contributed by the group; null when the platform-month total is 0. - regional_conversion_concentration: fraction of platform-month total conversions contributed by the group; null when the platform-month total is 0. - Data quality dates: first_active_date is the minimum date_day; last_active_date is the maximum date_day. - Exclusions: retain only groups where at least one of impressions, clicks, or cost is greater than 0 for the month. - Load timestamp: _dbt_loaded_at is set to the current timestamp at model run time. - Final ordering: platform ascending, region ascending, month_year descending, then total_cost descending.'

- name: int_ad_reporting__time_series_analytics
      description: Advanced daily ad performance time series with moving averages, trends, anomalies, seasonality, forecasts, and recommendations (per platform, last 12 months)
      grain: One row per (date_day, platform)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report (date_day, campaign_id, impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, conversions_value)
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report (date_day, campaign_id, impressions, clicks, cost, purchases_30_d, sales_30_d)
      - raw.facebook_ads_basic_ad_data (date, ad_id, impressions, inline_link_clicks, spend)
      - raw.linkedin_ad_analytics_by_campaign_data (day, campaign_id, impressions, clicks, cost_in_usd, conversion_value_in_local_currency)
      business_logic: '- Ingest four ad sources, align fields, and union: - google_ads: cost comes from spend; conversions and conversion value as provided. - amazon_ads: conversions come from purchases_30_d; revenue uses sales_30_d; no conversion value. - facebook_ads: date is converted to date_day; ad_id is treated as the campaign identifier; conversions set to 0; clicks use inline_link_clicks; cost from spend. - linkedin_ads: day is converted to date_day; ensure impressions and cost are numeric; conversions use conversion_value_in_local_currency as an integer count; exclude rows with negative cost_in_usd. - Keep only records with date_day in the last 18 months, then aggregate by date_day and platform: - Sums: impressions, clicks, cost (spend), conversions, revenue (conversion value when present, else 30‑day revenue; missing treated as 0). - KPIs: CTR = 100×(clicks/impressions) rounded to 4 decimals when impressions>0, else 0; CPC = spend/clicks rounded to 2 decimals when clicks>0, else 0; CPA = spend/conversions rounded to 2 decimals when conversions>0, else 0; ROAS = revenue/spend rounded to 4 decimals when both >0, else 0. - Campaign indicators: active_campaigns = distinct campaigns; campaigns_with_clicks = distinct campaigns with clicks>0; market_active_day = 1 when total impressions>0, else 0. - Derive calendar features: day_of_week (0=Sun..6=Sat), week_of_year, month_of_year, quarter_of_year, day_type (WEEKEND when Sun/Sat else WEEKDAY), month_period (EARLY/MID/LATE/END by day of month), and seasonal_period using explicit US seasonal date rules. For trend math, compute days since 1970‑01‑01 as a whole‑day index. - Rolling metrics are computed per platform ordered by date_day and include the current day; if fewer than N days exist, use the available days: - Moving averages: last 7 days (spend, ctr, cpc), last 30 days (spend, ctr, cpc), and last 90 days (spend). - spend_ewma is approximated as the same 7‑day simple average of spend. - Volatility: sample standard deviation over the last 30 days for ctr and cpc. - Trend and seasonality: - 90‑day rolling linear trend slopes for spend and ctr using the day index (days since epoch). - Prior‑period references: values from 365, 30, and 7 days earlier for YoY, MoM, and WoW comparisons. - Baselines: average ctr and spend by day_of_week, and by month_of_year, over the available 18‑month input window. - Anomalies and momentum: - Percent change vs prior periods is computed when the prior value is >0; otherwise NULL. - z‑scores are absolute deviations from the 30‑day mean scaled by the 30‑day standard deviation; 0 when the standard deviation is not positive. - Day‑of‑week deviation is the absolute percent difference from the day‑of‑week average; NULL when the baseline is zero. - Momentum: spend is ACCELERATING when the 7‑day average exceeds 110% of the 30‑day average, DECELERATING when below 90%, else STABLE; ctr is IMPROVING when the 7‑day average exceeds 105% of the 30‑day average, DECLINING when below 95%, else STABLE. - Trend direction from the 90‑day spend slope: STRONG_UPTREND (>0.1), MILD_UPTREND (>0 to 0.1], STRONG_DOWNTREND (<-0.1), MILD_DOWNTREND (<0 to -0.1], else SIDEWAYS. - Forecasting and confidence: - 30‑day trend forecasts add 30 times the 90‑day slope to the 30‑day average (for spend and ctr). - Seasonal factors are ratios of the daily values to the corresponding monthly averages; NULL when the monthly average is zero. - Confidence bounds are the 30‑day average minus/plus two 30‑day standard deviations. - Market signals and actions: - market_state precedence: ANOMALOUS when ctr_z_score>2 or cpc_z_score>2; else VOLATILE when WoW spend change is >50% or <‑50%; else OPTIMIZING when ctr momentum is IMPROVING and spend momentum is STABLE; else SCALING when spend momentum is ACCELERATING and ctr momentum is STABLE; else NORMAL. - requires_investigation is true when ctr_z_score>3, or cpc_z_score>3, or absolute WoW spend change exceeds 200%; otherwise false. - optimization_recommendation: OPTIMIZE_TARGETING when ctr is DECLINING and spend is ACCELERATING; OPTIMIZE_BIDDING when cpc_z_score>2 and ctr momentum is STABLE; SEASONAL_ADJUSTMENT_NEEDED when spend seasonal factor>1.2 and ctr seasonal factor<0.8; SCALE_OPPORTUNITY when market_state is SCALING; otherwise MONITOR. - Finalize by keeping only the last 12 months, ordering by platform ascending and date_day descending, and stamping analysis_generated_at with the current timestamp.'

      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the metrics; final output includes only the last 12 months
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad platform identifier ('google_ads','amazon_ads','facebook_ads','linkedin_ads')
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: day_of_week
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Day of week where 0=Sunday and 6=Saturday
      - name: day_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: WEEKEND when day_of_week is 0 or 6; otherwise WEEKDAY
      - name: week_of_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar week number of date_day
      - name: month_of_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Month number 1–12 of date_day
      - name: quarter_of_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Quarter number 1–4 of date_day
      - name: seasonal_period
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Season tag: HOLIDAY_SEASON, BLACK_FRIDAY_WEEK, SUMMER_SEASON, BACK_TO_SCHOOL_SEASON, or REGULAR_PERIOD'
      - name: month_period
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: EARLY_MONTH (1–7), MID_MONTH (8–15), LATE_MONTH (16–23), or END_MONTH (24+)
      - name: daily_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions across all campaigns for the platform and date
      - name: daily_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks across all campaigns for the platform and date
      - name: daily_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of cost across all campaigns for the platform and date; LinkedIn rows with negative cost are excluded
      - name: daily_conversions
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of conversions across all campaigns for the platform and date
      - name: daily_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of conversion value when present, else 30‑day revenue; missing values treated as 0
      - name: daily_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If impressions>0, clicks divided by impressions times 100 rounded to 4 decimals; otherwise 0
      - name: daily_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If clicks>0, spend divided by clicks rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise 0
      - name: daily_cpa
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If conversions>0, spend divided by conversions rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise 0
      - name: daily_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If spend>0 and revenue>0, revenue divided by spend rounded to 4 decimals; otherwise 0
      - name: active_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct campaign_id per platform and date (Facebook uses ad_id as campaign_id)
      - name: campaigns_with_clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct campaign_id with clicks>0 per platform and date
      - name: market_active_day
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if total impressions>0; otherwise 0
      - name: spend_7d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7‑day moving average of daily_spend per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: spend_30d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30‑day moving average of daily_spend per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: spend_90d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 90‑day moving average of daily_spend per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: spend_ewma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Approximate EWMA represented as the same 7‑day moving average of daily_spend per platform
      - name: ctr_7d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7‑day moving average of daily_ctr per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: ctr_30d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30‑day moving average of daily_ctr per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: cpc_7d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7‑day moving average of daily_cpc per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: cpc_30d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30‑day moving average of daily_cpc per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: ctr_30d_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 30‑day sample standard deviation of daily_ctr per platform
      - name: cpc_30d_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 30‑day sample standard deviation of daily_cpc per platform
      - name: spend_trend_slope_90d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Slope of the 90‑day rolling linear trend of daily_spend versus days since epoch (per platform)
      - name: ctr_trend_slope_90d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Slope of the 90‑day rolling linear trend of daily_ctr versus days since epoch (per platform)
      - name: spend_trend_direction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend class from the 90‑day spend slope: STRONG_UPTREND, MILD_UPTREND, STRONG_DOWNTREND, MILD_DOWNTREND, or SIDEWAYS'
      - name: spend_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ACCELERATING if 7‑day spend average >110% of 30‑day; DECELERATING if <90%; else STABLE
      - name: ctr_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: IMPROVING if 7‑day ctr average >105% of 30‑day; DECLINING if <95%; else STABLE
      - name: spend_yoy_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs the same day 365 days earlier when the prior value>0; otherwise NULL
      - name: spend_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs 30 days earlier when the prior value>0; otherwise NULL
      - name: spend_wow_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs 7 days earlier when the prior value>0; otherwise NULL
      - name: ctr_z_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute z‑score of daily_ctr vs its 30‑day mean and standard deviation; 0 when the standard deviation≤0
      - name: cpc_z_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute z‑score of daily_cpc vs its 30‑day mean and standard deviation; 0 when the standard deviation≤0
      - name: ctr_dow_deviation_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute percent deviation from the day‑of‑week average ctr; NULL when the baseline is zero
      - name: spend_dow_deviation_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute percent deviation from the day‑of‑week average spend; NULL when the baseline is zero
      - name: dow_avg_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_ctr per platform and day_of_week over the 18‑month input window
      - name: dow_avg_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_spend per platform and day_of_week over the 18‑month input window
      - name: monthly_avg_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_ctr per platform and month_of_year over the 18‑month input window
      - name: monthly_avg_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_spend per platform and month_of_year over the 18‑month input window
      - name: spend_seasonal_factor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of daily_spend to monthly_avg_spend; NULL when the monthly average is zero
      - name: ctr_seasonal_factor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of daily_ctr to monthly_avg_ctr; NULL when the monthly average is zero
      - name: spend_30d_trend_forecast
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: '30‑day outlook: 30‑day average plus 30 times the 90‑day spend trend slope'
      - name: ctr_30d_trend_forecast
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: '30‑day outlook: 30‑day average plus 30 times the 90‑day ctr trend slope'
      - name: spend_lower_confidence
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Lower bound: 30‑day average minus two 30‑day standard deviations'
      - name: spend_upper_confidence
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Upper bound: 30‑day average plus two 30‑day standard deviations'
      - name: market_state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Market classification: ANOMALOUS, VOLATILE, OPTIMIZING, SCALING, or NORMAL based on z‑scores, WoW change, and momentum'
      - name: requires_investigation
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when ctr_z_score>3 or cpc_z_score>3 or absolute WoW spend change>200%; otherwise false
      - name: optimization_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action hint: OPTIMIZE_TARGETING, OPTIMIZE_BIDDING, SEASONAL_ADJUSTMENT_NEEDED, SCALE_OPPORTUNITY, or MONITOR'
      - name: analysis_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the analysis row was generated (current time at query runtime)

WITH execution_clock AS (
    SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS processed_at
),
amazon_rows AS (
    SELECT
        'amazon_ads'::VARCHAR AS platform,
        CAST(campaign_id AS VARCHAR) AS campaign_id,
        date_day,
        CAST(campaign_bidding_strategy AS VARCHAR) AS campaign_type,
        CAST(campaign_budget_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS daily_budget,
        campaign_budget_currency_code AS currency,
        'PRODUCT_SALES'::VARCHAR AS conversion_type,
        CAST(impressions AS BIGINT) AS impressions,
        CAST(clicks AS BIGINT) AS clicks,
        CAST(cost AS DOUBLE) AS cost,
        CAST(sales_7_d AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS revenue_7d,
        CAST(sales_30_d AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS revenue_30d,
        CAST(purchases_30_d AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS conversions,
        CAST(click_through_rate AS DOUBLE) AS click_through_rate,
        CAST(cost_per_click AS DOUBLE) AS cost_per_click,
        CAST(return_on_ad_spend AS DOUBLE) AS return_on_ad_spend,
        _dbt_loaded_at AS source_updated_at
    FROM staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report
    WHERE COALESCE(clicks, 0) >= 0 AND COALESCE(impressions, 0) >= 0 AND COALESCE(cost, 0) >= 0
),
google_rows AS (
    SELECT
        'google_ads'::VARCHAR AS platform,
        CAST(campaign_id AS VARCHAR) AS campaign_id,
        date_day,
        COALESCE(CAST(ad_network_type AS VARCHAR), 'SEARCH') AS campaign_type,
        NULL::DECIMAL(18,2) AS daily_budget,
        'USD'::VARCHAR AS currency,
        'ONLINE_CONVERSION'::VARCHAR AS conversion_type,
        CAST(COALESCE(impressions, 0) AS BIGINT) AS impressions,
        CAST(COALESCE(clicks, 0) AS BIGINT) AS clicks,
        CAST(COALESCE(spend, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cost,
        CAST(conversions_value AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS revenue_7d,
        CAST(conversions_value AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS revenue_30d,
        CAST(conversions AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS conversions,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(impressions, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(clicks, 0)::DOUBLE / impressions * 100, 4) ELSE 0 END AS click_through_rate,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(clicks, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(spend, 0) / clicks, 2) ELSE 0 END AS cost_per_click,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(spend, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(conversions_value, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(conversions_value / spend, 4) ELSE 0 END AS return_on_ad_spend,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS source_updated_at
    FROM staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report
    WHERE COALESCE(clicks, 0) >= 0 AND COALESCE(impressions, 0) >= 0 AND COALESCE(spend, 0) >= 0
),
facebook_rows AS (
    SELECT
        'facebook_ads'::VARCHAR AS platform,
        CAST(ad_id AS VARCHAR) AS campaign_id,
        date_day,
        'FACEBOOK_FEED'::VARCHAR AS campaign_type,
        NULL::DECIMAL(18,2) AS daily_budget,
        'USD'::VARCHAR AS currency,
        'ENGAGEMENT'::VARCHAR AS conversion_type,
        CAST(COALESCE(impressions, 0) AS BIGINT) AS impressions,
        CAST(COALESCE(inline_link_clicks, 0) AS BIGINT) AS clicks,
        CAST(COALESCE(spend, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cost,
        0::DECIMAL(18,2) AS revenue_7d,
        0::DECIMAL(18,2) AS revenue_30d,
        0::DECIMAL(12,2) AS conversions,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(impressions, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(inline_link_clicks, 0)::DOUBLE / impressions * 100, 4) ELSE 0 END AS click_through_rate,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(inline_link_clicks, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(spend, 0) / inline_link_clicks, 2) ELSE 0 END AS cost_per_click,
        0::DOUBLE AS return_on_ad_spend,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS source_updated_at
    FROM staging.stg_facebook_ads__ad_report
    WHERE COALESCE(spend, 0) >= 0 AND COALESCE(impressions, 0) >= 0
),
linkedin_rows AS (
    SELECT
        'linkedin_ads'::VARCHAR AS platform,
        CAST(campaign_id AS VARCHAR) AS campaign_id,
        TRY_CAST(day AS DATE) AS date_day,
        'LINKEDIN_SPONSORED'::VARCHAR AS campaign_type,
        NULL::DECIMAL(18,2) AS daily_budget,
        'USD'::VARCHAR AS currency,
        'LEAD_GENERATION'::VARCHAR AS conversion_type,
        CAST(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(impressions AS BIGINT), 0) AS BIGINT) AS impressions,
        CAST(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(clicks AS BIGINT), 0) AS BIGINT) AS clicks,
        CAST(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(cost_in_usd AS DOUBLE), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cost,
        0::DECIMAL(18,2) AS revenue_7d,
        0::DECIMAL(18,2) AS revenue_30d,
        CAST(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(conversion_value_in_local_currency AS INTEGER), 0) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS conversions,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(impressions AS BIGINT), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(clicks AS BIGINT), 0)::DOUBLE / TRY_CAST(impressions AS BIGINT) * 100, 4) ELSE 0 END AS click_through_rate,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(clicks AS BIGINT), 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(cost_in_usd AS DOUBLE), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(TRY_CAST(cost_in_usd AS DOUBLE) / TRY_CAST(clicks AS BIGINT), 2) ELSE 0 END AS cost_per_click,
        0::DOUBLE AS return_on_ad_spend,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS source_updated_at
    FROM raw.linkedin_ad_analytics_by_campaign_data
    WHERE COALESCE(TRY_CAST(cost_in_usd AS DOUBLE), 0) >= 0
),
base AS (
    SELECT * FROM amazon_rows
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM google_rows
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM facebook_rows
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM linkedin_rows
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        base.*,
        CASE
            WHEN base.platform = 'amazon_ads' AND base.click_through_rate >= 0.5 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN base.platform = 'amazon_ads' AND base.click_through_rate >= 0.2 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            WHEN base.platform = 'google_ads' AND base.click_through_rate >= 2.0 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN base.platform = 'google_ads' AND base.click_through_rate >= 0.8 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            WHEN base.platform = 'facebook_ads' AND base.click_through_rate >= 1.5 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN base.platform = 'facebook_ads' AND base.click_through_rate >= 0.9 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            WHEN base.click_through_rate >= 1.0 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN base.click_through_rate >= 0.5 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS ctr_performance_tier,
        CASE WHEN base.cost_per_click <= 0.5 THEN 'VERY_EFFICIENT' WHEN cost_per_click <= 1.5 THEN 'EFFICIENT' WHEN cost_per_click <= 3.0 THEN 'MODERATE' WHEN cost_per_click <= 5.0 THEN 'EXPENSIVE' ELSE 'VERY_EXPENSIVE' END AS cost_efficiency_tier,
        CASE WHEN base.platform NOT IN ('amazon_ads','google_ads') THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE' WHEN base.return_on_ad_spend >= 4 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN base.return_on_ad_spend >= 2 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN base.return_on_ad_spend >= 1 THEN 'BREAK_EVEN' WHEN base.return_on_ad_spend > 0 THEN 'LOSS_MAKING' ELSE 'NO_REVENUE' END AS roas_performance_tier,
        CASE WHEN base.impressions >= 10000 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN impressions >= 1000 THEN 'MEDIUM_VOLUME' WHEN impressions >= 100 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'MINIMAL_VOLUME' END AS volume_tier,
        MIN(date_day) OVER (PARTITION BY base.platform, base.campaign_id) AS first_campaign_date
    FROM base
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        metrics.*,
        DATE_DIFF('day', first_campaign_date, date_day)::BIGINT AS campaign_age_days,
        CASE WHEN metrics.impressions > 0 THEN ROUND(metrics.cost / metrics.impressions * 1000, 2) ELSE 0 END AS cost_per_mille,
        CASE WHEN metrics.conversions > 0 THEN ROUND(metrics.cost / metrics.conversions, 2) ELSE 0 END AS cost_per_conversion,
        clicks > impressions OR cost < 0 OR click_through_rate > 100 OR cost_per_click > 50 AS has_data_quality_issues
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    platform, campaign_id, date_day, campaign_type, daily_budget, currency, conversion_type,
    impressions, clicks, cost, revenue_7d, revenue_30d, conversions,
    click_through_rate, cost_per_click, return_on_ad_spend, cost_per_mille, cost_per_conversion,
    ctr_performance_tier, cost_efficiency_tier, roas_performance_tier, volume_tier, campaign_age_days,
    CASE WHEN campaign_age_days <= 7 THEN 'LAUNCH' WHEN campaign_age_days <= 30 THEN 'OPTIMIZATION' WHEN campaign_age_days <= 90 THEN 'MATURE' ELSE 'ESTABLISHED' END AS lifecycle_stage,
    has_data_quality_issues, source_updated_at, processed_at
FROM classified CROSS JOIN execution_clock
WHERE date_day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '365 days'
  AND impressions > 0
  AND NOT has_data_quality_issues

- name: int_ad_reporting__unified_campaign_metrics
      description: Unified daily campaign metrics across platforms with standardized KPIs, performance tiers, rolling 365‑day filter, and data quality screening
      grain: One row per platform, campaign_id, date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report
      - staging.stg_facebook_ads__ad_report
      - raw.linkedin_ad_analytics_by_campaign_data
      business_logic: 'Combine four platform feeds into a standardized base and apply filters per source: - Amazon Ads (staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report): - Map fields: platform=''amazon_ads''; campaign_type from campaign_bidding_strategy; daily_budget from campaign_budget_amount; currency from campaign_budget_currency_code; cost from source; revenue_7d from sales_7_d; revenue_30d from sales_30_d; conversions from purchases_30_d; conversion_type=''PRODUCT_SALES''; CTR, CPC, ROAS from source; source_updated_at from _dbt_loaded_at. - Keep rows where clicks, impressions, and cost are all non‑negative. - Google Ads (staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report): - Map fields: platform=''google_ads''; campaign_type from ad_network_type with default ''SEARCH''; daily_budget NULL; currency=''USD''; cost from spend; revenue_7d and revenue_30d both from conversions_value; conversions from conversions; conversion_type=''ONLINE_CONVERSION''. - KPIs: CTR as percentage (clicks ÷ impressions), rounded to 4 decimals and set to 0 when impressions=0; CPC as cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals and set to 0 when clicks=0; ROAS as revenue_7d ÷ cost when both are positive, else 0. - Set source_updated_at to the execution timestamp; keep rows where clicks, impressions, and spend are all non‑negative. - Facebook Ads (staging.stg_facebook_ads__ad_report): - Map fields: platform=''facebook_ads''; campaign_id from ad_id; campaign_type=''FACEBOOK_FEED''; daily_budget NULL; currency=''USD''; clicks from inline_link_clicks defaulting to 0; impressions defaulting to 0; cost from spend defaulting to 0; revenue_7d=0; revenue_30d=0; conversions=0; conversion_type=''ENGAGEMENT''. - KPIs: CTR as percentage (clicks ÷ impressions), rounded to 4 decimals and set to 0 when impressions=0; CPC as cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals and set to 0 when clicks=0; ROAS=0. - Set source_updated_at to the execution timestamp; keep rows where spend and impressions are non‑negative. - LinkedIn Ads (raw.linkedin_ad_analytics_by_campaign_data): - Map fields: platform=''linkedin_ads''; date_day from day; campaign_type=''LINKEDIN_SPONSORED''; daily_budget NULL; currency=''USD''; clicks defaulting to 0; impressions cast to integer and defaulting to 0; cost cast to decimal and defaulting to 0; revenue_7d=0; revenue_30d=0; conversions from conversion_value_in_local_currency cast to integer and defaulting to 0; conversion_type=''LEAD_GENERATION''. - KPIs: CTR as percentage (clicks ÷ impressions), rounded to 4 decimals and set to 0 when impressions=0; CPC as cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals and set to 0 unless both clicks and cost are positive; ROAS=0. - Set source_updated_at to the execution timestamp; keep rows where cost_in_usd is non‑negative. Enhance with performance metrics (computed on the full base before final filters): - ctr_performance_tier: platform‑specific thresholds on CTR (percent): - amazon_ads: HIGH when ≥0.5; MEDIUM when ≥0.2; else LOW. - google_ads: HIGH when ≥2.0; MEDIUM when ≥0.8; else LOW. - facebook_ads: HIGH when ≥1.5; MEDIUM when ≥0.9; else LOW. - others: HIGH when ≥1.0; MEDIUM when ≥0.5; else LOW. - cost_efficiency_tier: VERY_EFFICIENT when CPC≤0.5; EFFICIENT when ≤1.5; MODERATE when ≤3.0; EXPENSIVE when ≤5.0; else VERY_EXPENSIVE. - roas_performance_tier: for amazon_ads and google_ads, classify ROAS as EXCELLENT when ≥4.0; GOOD when ≥2.0; BREAK_EVEN when ≥1.0; LOSS_MAKING when >0; else NO_REVENUE; other platforms NOT_APPLICABLE. - campaign_age_days: days since the earliest observed date_day for the platform and campaign_id in the full base (not limited to the 365‑day window). - volume_tier: HIGH_VOLUME when impressions≥10,000; MEDIUM_VOLUME when ≥1,000; LOW_VOLUME when ≥100; else MINIMAL_VOLUME. Final selection and additional computations: - cost_per_mille (CPM): cost per 1,000 impressions, rounded to 2 decimals; set to 0 when impressions=0. - cost_per_conversion: cost ÷ conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; set to 0 when conversions=0. - lifecycle_stage from campaign_age_days: LAUNCH when ≤7; OPTIMIZATION when ≤30; MATURE when ≤90; else ESTABLISHED. - has_data_quality_issues: TRUE when clicks>impressions or cost<0 or CTR>100 or CPC>50; otherwise FALSE. - processed_at set to the execution timestamp. Apply final filters: - Keep rows where date_day is within the last 365 days relative to execution. - Keep rows where impressions>0. - Exclude rows flagged with has_data_quality_issues (output rows have has_data_quality_issues=FALSE). Notes: - Inputs are combined without deduplication; no ordering is enforced. - Rounding: CTR to 4 decimals (for computed platforms), CPC to 2 decimals, CPM to 2 decimals, cost_per_conversion to 2 decimals. - Units: CTR is a percentage; CPC/CPM/cost_per_conversion and cost are in the stated currency (USD for Google/Facebook/LinkedIn; Amazon uses its source currency); ROAS is a ratio. - CURRENT_DATE and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP are evaluated at query execution time.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Ad platform identifier: ''amazon_ads'', ''google_ads'', ''facebook_ads'', or ''linkedin_ads'''
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source campaign identifier (Facebook uses ad_id as campaign_id)
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Metric date; only rows within the rolling last 365 days relative to execution are kept
      - name: campaign_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Platform-specific campaign type (Amazon=bidding strategy, Google=ad_network_type default 'SEARCH', Facebook='FACEBOOK_FEED', LinkedIn='LINKEDIN_SPONSORED')
      - name: daily_budget
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Daily budget amount (Amazon only from campaign_budget_amount; NULL for other platforms; currency given by currency column)
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR

specification.name: int_ad_reporting__unified_campaign_metrics
specification.description: Unified daily campaign metrics across platforms with standardized KPIs, performance tiers, rolling 365‑day filter, and data quality screening
specification.grain: One row per platform, campaign_id, date_day
specification.business_logic: Combine four platform feeds into a standardized base and apply filters per source: - Amazon Ads (staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report): - Map fields: platform='amazon_ads'; campaign_type from campaign_bidding_strategy; daily_budget from campaign_budget_amount; currency from campaign_budget_currency_code; cost from source; revenue_7d from sales_7_d; revenue_30d from sales_30_d; conversions from purchases_30_d; conversion_type='PRODUCT_SALES'; CTR, CPC, ROAS from source; source_updated_at from _dbt_loaded_at. - Keep rows where clicks, impressions, and cost are all non‑negative. - Google Ads (staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report): - Map fields: platform='google_ads'; campaign_type from ad_network_type with default 'SEARCH'; daily_budget NULL; currency='USD'; cost from spend; revenue_7d and revenue_30d both from conversions_value; conversions from conversions; conversion_type='ONLINE_CONVERSION'. - KPIs: CTR as percentage (clicks ÷ impressions), rounded to 4 decimals and set to 0 when impressions=0; CPC as cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals and set to 0 when clicks=0; ROAS as revenue_7d ÷ cost when both are positive, else 0. - Set source_updated_at to the execution timestamp; keep rows where clicks, impressions, and spend are all non‑negative. - Facebook Ads (staging.stg_facebook_ads__ad_report): - Map fields: platform='facebook_ads'; campaign_id from ad_id; campaign_type='FACEBOOK_FEED'; daily_budget NULL; currency='USD'; clicks from inline_link_clicks defaulting to 0; impressions defaulting to 0; cost from spend defaulting to 0; revenue_7d=0; revenue_30d=0; conversions=0; conversion_type='ENGAGEMENT'. - KPIs: CTR as percentage (clicks ÷ impressions), rounded to 4 decimals and set to 0 when impressions=0; CPC as cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals and set to 0 when clicks=0; ROAS=0. - Set source_updated_at to the execution timestamp; keep rows where spend and impressions are non‑negative. - LinkedIn Ads (raw.linkedin_ad_analytics_by_campaign_data): - Map fields: platform='linkedin_ads'; date_day from day; campaign_type='LINKEDIN_SPONSORED'; daily_budget NULL; currency='USD'; clicks defaulting to 0; impressions cast to integer and defaulting to 0; cost cast to decimal and defaulting to 0; revenue_7d=0; revenue_30d=0; conversions from conversion_value_in_local_currency cast to integer and defaulting to 0; conversion_type='LEAD_GENERATION'. - KPIs: CTR as percentage (clicks ÷ impressions), rounded to 4 decimals and set to 0 when impressions=0; CPC as cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals and set to 0 unless both clicks and cost are positive; ROAS=0. - Set source_updated_at to the execution timestamp; keep rows where cost_in_usd is non‑negative. Enhance with performance metrics (computed on the full base before final filters): - ctr_performance_tier: platform‑specific thresholds on CTR (percent): - amazon_ads: HIGH when ≥0.5; MEDIUM when ≥0.2; else LOW. - google_ads: HIGH when ≥2.0; MEDIUM when ≥0.8; else LOW. - facebook_ads: HIGH when ≥1.5; MEDIUM when ≥0.9; else LOW. - others: HIGH when ≥1.0; MEDIUM when ≥0.5; else LOW. - cost_efficiency_tier: VERY_EFFICIENT when CPC≤0.5; EFFICIENT when ≤1.5; MODERATE when ≤3.0; EXPENSIVE when ≤5.0; else VERY_EXPENSIVE. - roas_performance_tier: for amazon_ads and google_ads, classify ROAS as EXCELLENT when ≥4.0; GOOD when ≥2.0; BREAK_EVEN when ≥1.0; LOSS_MAKING when >0; else NO_REVENUE; other platforms NOT_APPLICABLE. - campaign_age_days: days since the earliest observed date_day for the platform and campaign_id in the full base (not limited to the 365‑day window). - volume_tier: HIGH_VOLUME when impressions≥10,000; MEDIUM_VOLUME when ≥1,000; LOW_VOLUME when ≥100; else MINIMAL_VOLUME. Final selection and additional computations: - cost_per_mille (CPM): cost per 1,000 impressions, rounded to 2 decimals; set to 0 when impressions=0. - cost_per_conversion: cost ÷ conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; set to 0 when conversions=0. - lifecycle_stage from campaign_age_days: LAUNCH when ≤7; OPTIMIZATION when ≤30; MATURE when ≤90; else ESTABLISHED. - has_data_quality_issues: TRUE when clicks>impressions or cost<0 or CTR>100 or CPC>50; otherwise FALSE. - processed_at set to the execution timestamp. Apply final filters: - Keep rows where date_day is within the last 365 days relative to execution. - Keep rows where impressions>0. - Exclude rows flagged with has_data_quality_issues (output rows have has_data_quality_issues=FALSE). Notes: - Inputs are combined without deduplication; no ordering is enforced. - Rounding: CTR to 4 decimals (for computed platforms), CPC to 2 decimals, CPM to 2 decimals, cost_per_conversion to 2 decimals. - Units: CTR is a percentage; CPC/CPM/cost_per_conversion and cost are in the stated currency (USD for Google/Facebook/LinkedIn; Amazon uses its source currency); ROAS is a ratio. - CURRENT_DATE and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP are evaluated at query execution time.

- name: ad_reporting__executive_dashboard
      description: Executive monthly ad performance, customer, and geographic KPIs with strategic insights (one row per month)
      grain: One row per reporting_month
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__unified_campaign_metrics
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__customer_journey_analysis
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__geo_channel_performance
      business_logic: '- Executive KPIs (last 12 months): For each platform and month, compute monthly investment (sum of spend), average daily spend, active days, totals for impressions/clicks/conversions/revenue, average CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS (CTR and ROAS rounded to 4 decimals; CPC and CPA to 2), and volatility as the standard deviation of daily CTR (rounded to 4) and CPC (rounded to 2). Growth and anomaly placeholders are set to zero. - Customer insights (last 12 months): For each acquisition cohort month, compute new customers (distinct count), cohort revenue (sum), average customer value and lifespan, counts of high-value, highly engaged, and frequent converters, average retention for months 1–3, average customer ROAS and order value, average platforms used per customer, and count of multi-platform customers (used more than one platform). - Geographic performance (last 6 months): For each month and region, compute active countries (distinct count), regional investment (sum), average market CTR and CPC, spend in high-opportunity markets (sum) and count of such markets, mature market ratio (share of markets classified as mature), average market share and performance percentiles, and average multi-channel adoption. - Unified performance (last 12 months): For each month, compute active platforms (distinct count), monthly totals for impressions/clicks/spend/conversions/revenue, blended averages for CTR/CPC/ROAS (rounded as above), variance across platforms for CTR (rounded to 4) and CPC (rounded to 2), designate platform leaders (CTR leader is google_ads; efficiency and ROAS leaders are amazon_ads), and campaign metrics (distinct active campaigns, average campaign age, counts of new vs established campaigns). - Strategic insights by month: - Investment efficiency grade from overall ROAS thresholds (≥3.0, ≥2.0, ≥1.0, else). - Month-over-month growth rate as percent change in monthly spend versus the prior month, rounded to 2, and set to NULL if no prior month exists. - Portfolio diversification based on active platforms and CTR variance. - Expansion mode based on the ratio of new to established campaigns. - Performance consistency based on CTR and CPC variance thresholds. - Carry forward monthly totals, blended metrics, counts, and platform leaders. - Final output: Start from strategic insights; left join platform-level KPIs by month; left join cohort-level customer insights by cohort month; left join regional geographic performance by month; filter to the last 6 reporting months; group by month and the exposed categorical fields. - Aggregate per reporting_month: customer and geographic metrics are averaged or summed across joined rows; leader platform KPIs are taken from the platform that matches the designated leader; anomaly days use the maximum; performance volatility uses the average; platform growth uses the average; scaling and optimizing days use sums. - Recommendations and strategies: - Executive recommendation based on efficiency grade, consistency, expansion status, growth rate, and overall ROAS (with a default fallback). - Allocation strategy prioritizes when efficiency and ROAS leaders align; else considers low overall ROAS; else considers high average spend in high-opportunity markets; else defaults. Comparisons against aggregated values treat NULLs as not satisfying thresholds. - Customer strategy insight evaluates retention, high-value customer mix (with zero-division protection), and cross-platform engagement, with a default fallback. - Data quality and metadata: platforms_with_data is the count of platforms present in the platform KPI join for the month (0 when none); analysis_period_start and analysis_period_end both equal the reporting_month; dashboard_generated_at is the current timestamp; results are ordered by reporting_month descending.'

      - name: overall_cpc

        description: Blended CPC across platforms rounded to 2 decimals; may be NULL
      - name: investment_efficiency_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Efficiency grade derived from overall ROAS thresholds; not null
      - name: month_over_month_growth_rate

        description: Percent change in monthly_ad_spend versus prior month rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when no prior month
      - name: portfolio_diversification

specification.name: ad_reporting__executive_dashboard
specification.description: Executive monthly ad performance, customer, and geographic KPIs with strategic insights (one row per month)
specification.business_logic: - Executive KPIs (last 12 months): For each platform and month, compute monthly investment (sum of spend), average daily spend, active days, totals for impressions/clicks/conversions/revenue, average CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS (CTR and ROAS rounded to 4 decimals; CPC and CPA to 2), and volatility as the standard deviation of daily CTR (rounded to 4) and CPC (rounded to 2). Growth and anomaly placeholders are set to zero. - Customer insights (last 12 months): For each acquisition cohort month, compute new customers (distinct count), cohort revenue (sum), average customer value and lifespan, counts of high-value, highly engaged, and frequent converters, average retention for months 1–3, average customer ROAS and order value, average platforms used per customer, and count of multi-platform customers (used more than one platform). - Geographic performance (last 6 months): For each month and region, compute active countries (distinct count), regional investment (sum), average market CTR and CPC, spend in high-opportunity markets (sum) and count of such markets, mature market ratio (share of markets classified as mature), average market share and performance percentiles, and average multi-channel adoption. - Unified performance (last 12 months): For each month, compute active platforms (distinct count), monthly totals for impressions/clicks/spend/conversions/revenue, blended averages for CTR/CPC/ROAS (rounded as above), variance across platforms for CTR (rounded to 4) and CPC (rounded to 2), designate platform leaders (CTR leader is google_ads; efficiency and ROAS leaders are amazon_ads), and campaign metrics (distinct active campaigns, average campaign age, counts of new vs established campaigns). - Strategic insights by month: - Investment efficiency grade from overall ROAS thresholds (≥3.0, ≥2.0, ≥1.0, else). - Month-over-month growth rate as percent change in monthly spend versus the prior month, rounded to 2, and set to NULL if no prior month exists. - Portfolio diversification based on active platforms and CTR variance. - Expansion mode based on the ratio of new to established campaigns. - Performance consistency based on CTR and CPC variance thresholds. - Carry forward monthly totals, blended metrics, counts, and platform leaders. - Final output: Start from strategic insights; left join platform-level KPIs by month; left join cohort-level customer insights by cohort month; left join regional geographic performance by month; filter to the last 6 reporting months; group by month and the exposed categorical fields. - Aggregate per reporting_month: customer and geographic metrics are averaged or summed across joined rows; leader platform KPIs are taken from the platform that matches the designated leader; anomaly days use the maximum; performance volatility uses the average; platform growth uses the average; scaling and optimizing days use sums. - Recommendations and strategies: - Executive recommendation based on efficiency grade, consistency, expansion status, growth rate, and overall ROAS (with a default fallback). - Allocation strategy prioritizes when efficiency and ROAS leaders align; else considers low overall ROAS; else considers high average spend in high-opportunity markets; else defaults. Comparisons against aggregated values treat NULLs as not satisfying thresholds. - Customer strategy insight evaluates retention, high-value customer mix (with zero-division protection), and cross-platform engagement, with a default fallback. - Data quality and metadata: platforms_with_data is the count of platforms present in the platform KPI join for the month (0 when none); analysis_period_start and analysis_period_end both equal the reporting_month; dashboard_generated_at is the current timestamp; results are ordered by reporting_month descending.

      business_logic: '- Build the baseline from unified campaign metrics limited to the last 12 months. - Group by platform and the calendar month of date_day; compute monthly totals (spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, 30-day revenue) and monthly averages (CTR rounded to 4 decimals, CPC rounded to 2, ROAS rounded to 4); all aggregations ignore NULLs. - Count distinct campaigns: active (all), new (lifecycle LAUNCH), and established (lifecycle ESTABLISHED); NULL campaign IDs are excluded. - Compute volatility as the standard deviation of CTR and CPC within each platform-month; if fewer than two non-NULL observations, volatility is NULL. - Per platform, order months chronologically to derive: - Month-over-month spend growth: percent change from the prior month (rounded to 2 decimals); if the prior value is not positive, set to 0. - Month-over-month CTR change: percent change from the prior month (rounded to 2 decimals); if the prior value is not positive, set to 0. - 3-month rolling averages for spend, CTR, and ROAS using the current month and two preceding months. - Spend momentum: ACCELERATING if current spend is >10% above prior month, DECELERATING if >10% below, otherwise STABLE; if no prior month, STABLE. - CTR momentum: IMPROVING if current CTR is >5% above prior month, DECLINING if >5% below, otherwise STABLE; if no prior month, STABLE. - Predictions: - Next-month spend: 3-month spend average scaled by 1.15 when accelerating, 0.85 when decelerating, otherwise unchanged. - Next-month CTR: 3-month CTR average scaled by 1.10 when improving, 0.90 when declining, otherwise unchanged. - Risk level: HIGH_RISK when CTR volatility > 0.5 and MoM spend growth > 50%; MEDIUM_RISK when CTR volatility > 0.3 or absolute MoM spend growth > 25%; otherwise LOW_RISK. - Anomaly probability: 35 when CTR volatility > 1.0 or CPC volatility > 2.0; 20 when CTR volatility > 0.5 or CPC volatility > 1.0; 25 when absolute MoM spend growth > 50%; otherwise 10. - Confidence: HIGH_CONFIDENCE when absolute MoM spend growth < 10% and CTR volatility < 0.3; MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE when absolute MoM spend growth < 25% and CTR volatility < 0.5; otherwise LOW_CONFIDENCE. - Final output per platform-month: - Baselines: current_monthly_spend, current_avg_ctr, current_avg_cpc, current_avg_roas from the monthly aggregates. - Budget recommendation: increase if accelerating and ROAS ≥ 2.0; decrease if decelerating or ROAS < 1.0; otherwise maintain. - Predicted ROAS: +10% when ROAS ≥ 2.5 and CTR momentum improving; −10% when ROAS < 1.5 and CTR momentum declining; otherwise unchanged. - Risk mitigation and strategic recommendation are set to the exact strings defined by the CASE rules. - Revenue scenarios: expected revenue at current ROAS = predicted spend × current avg ROAS; optimized = predicted spend × predicted ROAS; incremental = predicted spend × (predicted ROAS − current avg ROAS). - Success probability: VERY_HIGH when confidence is HIGH and risk is LOW; HIGH when confidence is HIGH/MEDIUM and risk is not HIGH; MEDIUM when confidence is MEDIUM; otherwise LOW. - Metadata: generated timestamp at query run, base date is today, target date is 30 days after the base date. - Filter to months within the last six months;         data_type: VARCHAR

      - name: strategic_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Strategy label combining budget recommendation, risk, ROAS, CTR momentum, and anomaly risk; strings exactly as defined
      - name: expected_revenue_current_performance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Predicted spend × current average ROAS
      - name: expected_revenue_optimized_performance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Predicted spend × predicted ROAS
      - name: incremental_revenue_opportunity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Predicted spend × (predicted ROAS − current average ROAS)
      - name: prediction_success_probability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: VERY_HIGH when confidence is HIGH and risk is LOW; HIGH when confidence HIGH/MEDIUM and risk not HIGH; MEDIUM when confidence MEDIUM; else LOW
      - name: forecast_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE

      - name: forecast_base_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date when the query runs

        data_type: TIMESTAMP
